    public void Configure(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options)
    {
        if (_configuration is null)

            return;
        }

        if (section.Value is { Length: > 0 })
        {
            options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{SectionKey} is a value, and must be an object of keys. A connection string goes in {ConnectionStringKey}.");
        }

        foreach (var child in section.GetChildren())
        {
            var where = $"{SectionKey}:{child.Key}";

                    else

                    }
                }

                continue;
            }

            if (string.Equals(child.Key, "AllowedHosts", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                if (child.Value is { Length: > 0 })
                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{where} is a value, and must be an array of hosts (a comma-separated list is for a connection string).");
                }

                foreach (var host in child.GetChildren())
                {
                    if (host.Value is { Length: > 0 } value)
                    {
                        options.AllowedHosts.Add(value.Trim());
                    }
                }

                continue;
            }

            if (!Keys.TryGetValue(child.Key, out var name))
            {
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{SectionKey} has an unknown key, {child.Key}. Its keys are {ObjectKeyList}.");
                continue;
            }

            if (seen.TryGetValue(name, out var other))
            {
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{SectionKey} sets {name} twice, as {other} and as {child.Key}.");
                continue;
            }

            seen[name] = child.Key;
            if (child.Value is null)
            {
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{where} is an object, and must be a value.");
                continue;
            }

            Apply(options, name, child.Value, where);
        }

    /// <summary>
    ///     Applies the connection string over everything else: <c>Clients:RocketsClient:ConnectionString</c> when that key exists (an
    ///     empty value meaning none), else <c>ConnectionStrings:RocketsClient</c>. The two are never merged.
    /// </summary>
    public void PostConfigure(string? name, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options)
    {
        if ((name ?? global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.Options.DefaultName) != global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.Options.DefaultName || _configuration is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        var source = ConnectionStringKey;
        var connectionString = _configuration.GetSection(ConnectionStringKey).Value;
        if (connectionString is null)
        {
            source = FallbackConnectionStringKey;
            connectionString = _configuration[FallbackConnectionStringKey];
        }

        if (connectionString is { Length: > 0 })
        {
            ApplyConnectionString(options, connectionString, source);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Checks the options, whichever source set them.</summary>
    public global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.ValidateOptionsResult Validate(string? name, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options)
    {
        if ((name ?? global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.Options.DefaultName) != global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.Options.DefaultName)
        {
            return global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.ValidateOptionsResult.Skip;
        }

        var failures = new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<string>(options.ConfigurationErrors);
        if (options.BaseAddress is { Length: > 0 } baseAddress
         && !(global::System.Uri.TryCreate(baseAddress, global::System.UriKind.Absolute, out var uri)
           && (uri.Scheme == global::System.Uri.UriSchemeHttp || uri.Scheme == global::System.Uri.UriSchemeHttps)))
        {
            failures.Add("The BaseAddress of RocketsClient is not an absolute http or https URI.");
        }

        if (options.Timeout is { } timeout
         && timeout != global::System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan
         && (timeout <= global::System.TimeSpan.Zero || timeout.TotalMilliseconds > int.MaxValue))
        {
            failures.Add("The Timeout of RocketsClient must be positive and at most 24.20:31:23.647, or infinite (-00:00:00.001).");
        }

        foreach (var header in options.DefaultRequestHeaders)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header.Key))
            {
                failures.Add("The DefaultRequestHeaders of RocketsClient have a header without a name.");
            }
        }

        foreach (var host in options.AllowedHosts)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(host))
            {
                failures.Add("The AllowedHosts of RocketsClient have an empty host.");
            }
        }

        ValidateAuthentication(options, failures);
        return failures.Count == 0
            ? global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.ValidateOptionsResult.Success
            : global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.ValidateOptionsResult.Fail(failures);
    }

    // the keys each method needs, and that no other method's keys are set
    private static void ValidateAuthentication(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options, global::System.Collections.Generic.List<string> failures)
    {
        switch (options.Authentication)
        {
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.None:
                break;
            default:
                failures.Add($"The Authentication of RocketsClient is not a method it can use: {AuthenticationList}.");
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     Parses a connection string with the syntax of <c>DbConnectionStringBuilder</c> (<c>key=value</c> pairs separated by <c>;</c>, a
    ///     value quoted with <c>'</c> or <c>"</c> when it holds a <c>;</c> or leading or trailing spaces, a doubled quote standing for
    ///     itself), and applies it. An unknown key, a key given twice (an alias with its key too) and a malformed string are errors.
    /// </summary>
    private static void ApplyConnectionString(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options, string connectionString, string source)
    {
        var seen = new global::System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, string>(global::System.StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var unknown = false;
        var i = 0;
        while (true)
        {
            while (i < connectionString.Length && (connectionString[i] == ';' || char.IsWhiteSpace(connectionString[i])))
            {
                i++;
            }

            if (i == connectionString.Length)
            {
                break;
            }

            var keyStart = i;
            while (i < connectionString.Length && connectionString[i] != '=' && connectionString[i] != ';')
            {
                i++;
            }

            if (i == connectionString.Length || connectionString[i] != '=')
            {
                // the text may be a secret written without its key: it isn't repeated
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{source} has a part that isn't key=value.");
                return;
            }

            var key = connectionString.Substring(keyStart, i - keyStart).Trim();
            i++;
            while (i < connectionString.Length && connectionString[i] != ';' && char.IsWhiteSpace(connectionString[i]))
            {
                i++;
            }

            string value;
            if (i < connectionString.Length && (connectionString[i] == SingleQuote || connectionString[i] == '"'))
            {
                var quote = connectionString[i++];
                var builder = new global::System.Text.StringBuilder();
                var closed = false;
                while (i < connectionString.Length)
                {
                    if (connectionString[i] == quote)
                    {
                        if (i + 1 < connectionString.Length && connectionString[i + 1] == quote)
                        {
                            builder.Append(quote);
                            i += 2;
                            continue;
                        }

                        i++;
                        closed = true;
                        break;
                    }

                    builder.Append(connectionString[i++]);
                }

                if (!closed)
                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{source} has a quoted value without its closing quote, for {key}.");
                    return;
                }

                while (i < connectionString.Length && char.IsWhiteSpace(connectionString[i]))
                {
                    i++;
                }

                if (i < connectionString.Length && connectionString[i] != ';')
                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{source} has more after the closing quote of the value of {key}.");
                    return;
                }

                value = builder.ToString();
            }
            else
            {
                var valueStart = i;
                while (i < connectionString.Length && connectionString[i] != ';')
                {
                    i++;
                }

                value = connectionString.Substring(valueStart, i - valueStart).Trim();
            }

            if (key.Length == 0)
            {
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{source} has a value without a key.");
                continue;
            }

            if (!Keys.TryGetValue(key, out var name))
            {
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add(
                    string.Equals(key, "DefaultRequestHeaders", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        ? $"{source} has DefaultRequestHeaders, which only {SectionKey} can set."
                        : $"{source} has an unknown key, {key}. Its keys are {ConnectionStringKeyList}."
                );
                unknown = true;
                continue;
            }

            if (seen.TryGetValue(name, out var other))
            {
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{source} sets {name} twice, as {other} and as {key}.");
                continue;
            }

            seen[name] = key;
            if (value.Length > 0)
            {
                Apply(options, name, value, $"{source} ({key})");
            }
        }

        if (unknown && source == FallbackConnectionStringKey)
        {
            options.ConfigurationErrors.Add(
                $"When {FallbackConnectionStringKey} is the connection string of something else, set {ConnectionStringKey} to an empty value: the client then doesn't read it."
            );
        }
    }

    // sets the option a key stands for from its text
    private static void Apply(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options, string name, string value, string where)
    {
        switch (name)
        {
            case "BaseAddress":
                options.BaseAddress = value;
                break;
            case "Timeout":
                if (global::System.TimeSpan.TryParse(value, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var timeout))
                {
                    options.Timeout = timeout;
                }
                else
                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{where} is not a TimeSpan, such as 00:00:30.");
                }

                break;
            case "Resilience":
                if (bool.TryParse(value, out var resilience))
                {
                    options.Resilience = resilience;
                }
                else
                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{where} is not true or false.");
                }

                break;
            case "AllowedHosts":
                options.AllowedHosts.Clear();
                foreach (var host in value.Split(','))
                {
                    if (host.Trim() is { Length: > 0 } trimmed)
                    {
                        options.AllowedHosts.Add(trimmed);
                    }
                }

                break;
            case "Authentication":
                if (string.Equals(value, "None", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    options.Authentication = global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.None;
                }
                else
                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{where} is not a method RocketsClient can use: {AuthenticationList}.");
                }

                break;
        }
    }
